episodes.synopsis: A certain world is surrounded by huge walls. Then all of a sudden Lupin over 30m invades there... Yoshihiko and Kuniko are trembling in fear... And Lupin attacks Kuniko's house! Now Lupin steals someone?!
episodes.title: Attack on Lupin

episodes.synopsis: Lupin lived as a son-in-law with the Saito family, an opinion leader in the region that continued from the Jomon period. The Saito family had an anomaly where everything in the house began to disappear, but the owner eventually wanted Lupin to take over the house...
episodes.title: Saito Lupin

episodes.synopsis: When the habit of visiting three times in my life gets worse... Yeah, that's Lupiky. Such Lupiky also visits Fujimoto. Without knowing, Fujimoto, who steals things inside the school, begins to show symptoms of Lupiky more and more.
episodes.title: Lupiky

episodes.synopsis: A creature that is neither a monster nor a youkai was picked up by Gregor. Lupin, Fujiko, and Jigen, when they grow up, go out into the city and start working... Eventually Gregor's house overflowed with gold...
episodes.title: Melting Man Lupin

episodes.synopsis: A tropical Lupin with a very strong power off the Philippines seems to land in Honshu tonight. Takeshi and Zenigata decided to take measures in preparation for Lupin landing... Is it possible to pass safely with the wind and rain increasing?!
episodes.title: Tropical Lupin

episodes.synopsis: Lupin III stole in a certain village in the Shimane prefecture. Lupin the 3rd, calling out to the villagers in search of a house to steal. Grandfather Tomiko heard about the situation and seems to let you steal Lupin...?
episodes.title: Steal in the Countryside!

episodes.synopsis: Tommy comes to the forest in search of her girlfriend Cathy and a raccoon. Then he saw the washed Lupin in a trap! Tommy decided to bring back the washed Lupin, but the wild washed Lupin couldn't be quiet...
episodes.title: Washing Lupin III

episodes.synopsis: A truck loaded with household belongings traveled on a peaceful country road. Mazurka and his family were about to start a new life here. However, when he arrived at his new house, there was a Western-style house next door where the Lupin gang lived...
episodes.title: My Neighbor Lupin

episodes.synopsis: The title is a portmanteau of ブラックホール (Burakkuhōru, Black Hole) and ルパン (Rupan, Lupin), this is lost when translated into other languages.
episodes.title: Blackholepin

episodes.synopsis: Despite the important time of taking an examination, a teacher with a title of inexperienced and great thief came as a homeroom teacher. A very friendly and unique Lupin teacher. One day at such a school, a wallet theft case occurs...
episodes.title: Conclusion from Lupin Sensei
